title: Flashing Lights [V2]
description: According to Eric Hudson, "So we was in the room and he was like, 'yo, you got a joint? My album’s closed, but if you can give me that one banger I’ll put it on there if it’s crazy.' So I start wonder, do I got CDs on me? And by the grace of God I had that beat man. He came into the other room and I played it for him. He listened to the beat for about ten seconds man…the beat didn’t even drop totally. He took it, put it in Pro Tools and did the song right then and there... He freestyled it and then next I’m hearing he went and put the “flashin’…lights, lights,” he put that on there, he did that in Chicago. That’s probably the quickest record that I’ve ever seen come about."
